decisions.reason: The wide-to-mid-to-closer progression applies to the character-pair image sequence, not the distinct deferred aerial establishing shot.
The framing order does not change the requirement that new sets remain stylistically consistent across shots.
The character-pair framing specification does not alter the requirement to use the revised script as the trailer's content source.
The specified wide-to-mid-to-closer framing progression does not modify the existing quality policy allowing shot-angle changes or newly generated set images when needed.
